text: Luck controls half your life. The other half... is yours.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Two students. Same surprise test... same bad luck.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Omar studied twenty minutes a night. When the storm hit... his walls were built.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli wrote... Fortune is the arbiter of one half of our actions... but she still leaves us to direct the other half... or perhaps a little less.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He compared fortune to a raging river. In calm weather... build your barriers.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The cautious man... when it is time to turn adventurous... does not know how to do it.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The habit that won yesterday... can sink you tomorrow. So change with the river.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Your action today: name one storm coming your way... and build one small wall against it before lunch.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What's your wall today? Comment below.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz for your daily mindset.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
